result.title: Searching the Pareto Front: Multi-Objective Retrieval for Heterogeneous Scientific Modalities
result.summary: In cosmology, surveys span different sky regions and wavelength ranges, resulting in uneven modality coverage across observational datasets. Such heterogeneity can be addressed through either multimodal foundation models (FMs), which learn shared embedding spaces, or independently learned modality embeddings combined via late fusion. We investigate whether the latter provides an adaptive alternative to FM-based scientific retrieval. We evaluate this approach on a galaxy retrieval task spanning diverse modalities--history of star formation, spectra of light emitted, and multi-wavelength observations from two telescopes--comparing an FM baseline with separately trained embeddings fused through multi-objective optimization based on Pareto optimality. We find that the FM baseline achieves strong embedding-space proximity, but our method preserves modality-specific distance structure that allows scientists to inspect which physical signals drive similarity. Our method also achieves improved fidelity in raw-data space: across six measured properties, its nearest neighbor is 8% closer to the query on average than that retrieved by kNN in the FM embedding space (spread 0.128 vs. 0.139). These results suggest that multi-objective retrieval can surface astrophysically coherent candidates that single-objective search alone may overlook.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究星系检索中的多模态科学数据融合，比较学习共享嵌入空间的多模态基础模型与分别训练各模态嵌入、再经 Pareto 多目标优化做晚期融合的方案，并用六项物理属性的原始数据距离评估检索保真度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「共享嵌入空间压缩模态特有距离结构、多目标晚期融合可保留并检视各模态贡献」这一线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中多源视觉证据是否被保留以及 latent 相似度诊断的设计。
